object.name: Traceweave witness (illustrative)
object.description: Illustrative only; no such service exists. Receives the SHA-256 of a registrant's DSSE signature, never content or fingerprints, and returns a signed, time-stamped witness statement. First to register is not first to create.

skills.name: Witness a registration digest
skills.description: Records that the authenticated caller presented this signature digest, signs a witness statement and attaches the witness's own RFC 3161 token. It does not register content, check authorship or check originality. First to register is not first to create.
